source: A ZXNAME0000XZ needs enough independent work to keep many streaming multiprocessors busy. In FA1, a natural unit of parallelism was roughly batchZXMATH0000XZ head. If batch size and head count were small, that could leave hardware under-occupied even when the sequence itself was long.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 需要足够的独立工作来保持许多流式多处理器繁忙。在 FA1 中，并行性的自然单位大致是 batchZXMATH0000XZ head。如果批量大小和人数都很小，即使序列本身很长，也可能导致硬件利用率不足。
